title: Contracting Tsetlin Machine with Absorbing Automata
new_feature: Absorbing Tsetlin automata: once a TA passes an absorbing Exclude (or Include) state it is removed permanently (literal discarded or fixed into the clause), using a sparse list-based clause structure so clauses contract during training, cutting training time; also discusses hardware TA circuits with absorbing states.

datasets.notes: CR has no official split; paper claims predefined splits
